mapper.select: SELECT FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at DESC
SELECT FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY finish_at ASC

SELECT node_code AS "nodeCode", node_name AS "nodeName", AVG(duration_ms) AS "avgDurationMs", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE flow_code = #{flowCode} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY node_code, node_name ORDER BY "avgDurationMs" DESC

SELECT node_code AS "nodeCode", MAX(node_name) AS "nodeName", MIN(finish_at) AS "firstFinishAt", COUNT(*) AS "visitCount" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND node_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY node_code ORDER BY MIN(finish_at) ASC

SELECT DISTINCT assignee_id FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id != '0' AND status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT assignee_id AS "assigneeId", MAX(assignee_name) AS "assigneeName", COUNT(1) AS "completedCount", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "avgDurationMs", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "totalDurationMs" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND assignee_id != '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finish_at >= #{startTime} AND finish_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY completedCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "totalTasks", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "completedTasks", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "rejectedTasks", CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(1) END AS "rejectionRate", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "avgDurationMs" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finish_at >= #{startTime} AND finish_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT DATE(finish_at) AS "date", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "totalCount", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "completedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "rejectedCount", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "avgDurationMs" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finish_at >= #{startTime} AND finish_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(finish_at) ORDER BY "date" ASC

SELECT flow_code AS "flowCode", MAX(flow_name) AS "flowName", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "totalCount", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "completedCount", SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "rejectedCount", CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS "rejectionRate", COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms > 0 THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "avgDurationMs" FROM ydsz_flow_his_task WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 AND task_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED') AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND finish_at >= #{startTime} AND finish_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY flow_code ORDER BY totalCount DESC
